overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. A CDBG topic raised in public comment and discussed during a noticed liaison report was related to that listed item, and the chair's failure to anticipate it did not make the discussion unlawful.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board discussed and decided a CDBG process issue that was not placed on the September 13, 2010 meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Board members do not violate the Open Meeting Law when they address a topic during a meeting that was not anticipated by the chair 48 hours in advance of the meeting.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
